title: Large blind test of methane-detecting satellites lends credibility to emissions data
title_zh: 大型盲测甲烷卫星数据可信度提升，排放数据更可靠
abstract: Teams that used various methods to analyse satellite data in a methane controlled-release test achieved mostly accurate results.
abstract_zh: 多个团队使用不同方法分析甲烷受控释放卫星数据，结果大多准确。
